events.title: NEWS! Popularity poll winner art, reviews open & soundtrack upload!
events.summary: Hey again everyone, and thank you so much for your votes in the TEKNOKRAT love interest popularity poll! As promised, here is the artwork of our lovely winner Bane, who won with 46% of the vote! Help like-minded players find TEKNOKRAT!We finally managed to figure out how to open the demo up to reviews! If you enjoyed our demo, we would really appreciate it if you took a moment to write us a review. A review helps us become more visible, and also helps players see if TEKNOKRAT is right for them!
